descriptionByLocale.it:
• Main Responsibilities
• Media Relations
• Support the Head of Media in implementing the Bank’s media strategy across Europe and the Middle East, with a particular focus on French-speaking Switzerland and key satellite markets.
• Coordinate with media agencies across EMEA to align priorities, timelines and deliverables
• Collaborate with Investment Services, regional teams and other subject-matter experts to source spokespeople and content, and coordinate the full approval process.
• Ensure timely, accurate and on-brand responses to journalists and media partners.
• Proactively coordinate interviews, briefings and market commentary with the relevant internal experts.
• Prepare and update key media materials (Q&As, talking points, short bios, background notes) as needed.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists in core financial and business media.
• Content Management & Copywriting
• Contribute to the production of high-quality content that supports the Bank’s positioning in investment strategy and asset management.
• Draft and edit press releases, statements, Q&As and opinion pieces in close collaboration with experts.
• Translate complex investment and market topics into clear, concise and compliant messages.
• Review and challenge the quality of content before it is offered to the media.
• Ensure consistency of tone of voice and alignment with the Bank’s brand and communication guidelines.
• Work in close partnership with the Digital team to amplify media coverage and align content.
• Coordinate with Internal Communications to share key media exposure internally.
• Monitoring & Reporting
• Monitor media coverage of the Bank, its experts and its key themes across EMEA.
• Use media monitoring and analytics tools to track visibility and sentiment.
• Prepare regular reports on media KPIs for the Head of Media and relevant stakeholders
• Your Profile
• Experience and Skills Required
• At least 5 years’ experience in media relations within financial services (banking, asset or wealth management) or in an agency with financial clients.
• Proven track record of working with financial and business media in an international environment.
• Strong understanding of the financial services landscape and media ecosystem.
• Excellent writing and editing skills; strong copywriting abilities under time pressure.
• Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines across regions in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience handling sensitive topics in a regulated context.
• Relationship builder, credible with journalists and confident with senior internal experts.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset and a hands-on, operational approach.
• Tools
• Experience with media monitoring and analytics platforms.
• Comfortable with basic data analysis and reporting for KPIs.
• Languages
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken).
• French speaker mandatory; other European languages are an advantage. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
